notes.title: Patch Update for August 14 - Fate Trigger CBT
notes.content: [p]Dear Awakeners,[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to deploy a patch update for the Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test on Thursday, August 14th, at 4:00 PM EDT. This update will be applied without server downtime. However, you will need to restart your game client to download the patch before you can log back in.[/p][p][/p][p]▼ Update Details:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/5622ea8b9f6a98da3dbaf873b7fa074a3cad9c40.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Weekend Training: Bonus Rewards Are Here![/b][/p][p]Play the Rapid Trials mode during the event to get Rank Protection Cards * 2. Squad up and rank up with confidence![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/011cee15655413d04ecf2527d46cd9a60eb4e496.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p] Fixed several issues that could cause crashes or stuttering in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the in-game FPS counter to display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where squad recruitment information would sometimes display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that could prevent squad missions from being completed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed various issues causing the leaderboards to display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where the rewards shown on the Awakener Access did not match the actual rewards received for certain levels.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed keybind configuration issues for the healing item wheel and the scoreboard in some controller layouts.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a UI bug where custom keybinds would sometimes display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed various controller interaction bugs.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug causing sensitivity settings not to apply correctly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issues with loot box interactions.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would sometimes display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issues with throwable item interactions.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue that could cause the camera perspective to switch incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the selected player in the reporting system to automatically reset.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug causing building textures to display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue that allowed Mindy's Ultimate ability to be cast at a teammate's location.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials where the contents of the Enhancement Station would sometimes display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug in Awakener Trials that sometimes prevented players from using the "Give Up" function.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue allowing players to clip through certain updraft areas in Awakener Trial.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed several locations in Awakener Trials where players could get stuck inside terrain.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug in Awakener Trials that could cause players to spawn in the wrong location after exiting a vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials where Supply Drops could sometimes fall off the map.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials that sometimes prevented Cynric from using ziplines.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue causing sound effects to behave incorrectly in the Training Grounds.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where the infinite ammo setting would sometimes fail in the Training Grounds.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue in Team Deathmatch mode where players would sometimes be in a falling state after respawning.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][i]Please remember that this CBT build does not represent the final version of the game. If you encounter any issues, please [/i]join our official Discord server [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]https://discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url][/p][p] [i]to submit bug reports and feedback. Our team will follow up and address them promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.[/i][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p]Fate Trigger Dev Team[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed several issues that could cause crashes or stuttering in some cases.
-Fixed a bug causing the in-game FPS counter to display incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where squad recruitment information would sometimes display incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug that could prevent squad missions from being completed correctly.
- Fixed various issues causing the leaderboards to display incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where the rewards shown on the Awakener Access did not match the actual rewards received for certain levels.
- Fixed keybind configuration issues for the healing item wheel and the scoreboard in some controller layouts.
- Fixed a UI bug where custom keybinds would sometimes display incorrectly.
- Fixed various controller interaction bugs.
- Fixed a bug causing sensitivity settings not to apply correctly.
- Fixed issues with loot box interactions.
- Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would sometimes display incorrectly.
- Fixed issues with throwable item interactions.
- Fixed an issue that could cause the camera perspective to switch incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the selected player in the reporting system to automatically reset.
- Fixed a bug causing building textures to display incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue allowing Mindy's Ultimate ability to be cast at a teammate's location.
- Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials where the contents of the Enhancement Station would sometimes display incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug in Awakener Trials that sometimes prevented players from using the "Give Up" function.
- Fixed an issue allowing players to clip through certain updraft areas in Awakener Trial.
- Fixed several locations in Awakener Trials where players could get stuck inside terrain.
- Fixed a bug in Awakener Trials that could cause players to spawn in the wrong location after exiting a vehicle.
- Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials where Supply Drops could sometimes fall off the map.
- Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials that sometimes prevented Cynric from using ziplines.
- Fixed an issue causing sound effects to behave incorrectly in the Training Grounds.
- Fixed a bug where the infinite ammo setting would sometimes fail in the Training Grounds.
- Fixed an issue in Team Deathmatch mode where players would sometimes be in a falling state after respawning.

notes.title: Patch Update for August 7 - Fate Trigger CBT

This update will be applied without server downtime. However, you will need to restart your game client to download the patch before you can log back in.[/p][p][/p][p][b]▼ Update Details:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/70ed1fe045cb270301e3ea682cfeed75c2ef5892.png"][/img][/p][olist][*][p]In the [b]Awakener Trial & Rapid Trial[/b] modes,  when a player is defeated, they will drop 50% of their currently held Supply Points in their loot box. If you encounter any issues, please [/i]join our official Discord server [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]https://discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url] [i]to submit bug reports and feedback. Our team will follow up and address them promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.[/i][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p]

tags.balance_change: In the [b]Awakener Trial & Rapid Trial[/b] modes,  when a player is defeated, they will drop 50% of their currently held Supply Points in their loot box. The player will then retain the remaining 50% of their points upon being revived.

tags.bug: Fixed issues related to performance optimization in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the Gladiator AR attachments displayed incorrectly in the Loadout system.
Fixed an issue where players could unexpectedly enter the training grounds in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the leaderboard displayed incorrectly in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the "Survive in the Shrinking Safe Zone" type task did not complete as expected in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the Awakener backgrounds displayed incorrectly in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the voice chat switched modes abnormally in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor displayed incorrectly in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where vehicles could still run when the fuel was empty in the Awakener Trial mode.

notes.title: Patch Update for July 31 - Fate Trigger CBT
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Dear Awakeners,[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to deploy a patch update for the [i]Fate Trigger[/i] Closed Beta Test on [b]Thursday, July 31st, at 4:00 PM EDT[/b].[/p][p]This update will be applied without server downtime. However, you will need to [b]restart your game client[/b] to download the patch before you can log back in.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Game Mode Arrival[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]>Team Deathmatch (FPP) - CBT Demo[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Time-Limited Mode, available for: [/b]Every Saturday and Sunday during the CBT from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight) [i]\[Depending on your server][/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mode Details:[/b] Squad up, pick your equipment, and rack up eliminations in this FPP! Victory goes to the first team to hit the score limit or the team with the most points when time's up![/p][/*][/list][p]*Note:[i] This is CBT demo which does not represent the final result. Feedback & suggestions are appreciated and will be carefully reviewed.
[/i][/p][h2][b]>Rapid Trials[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Time-Limited Mode, available for:[/b] Every Saturday and Sunday during the CBT from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight)[i] \[Depending on your server].[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mode Details:[/b] The Rapid Trial mode features a small-scale shrinking circle mechanism, offering a faster-paced combat experience. Awakeners can directly pick up and equip various weapon chips, while armor, compared to the Awakener Trial mode, comes with additional damage reduction. The TTK in this mode is also extended. Additionally, by accumulating damage to the enemies, your armor can evolve to higher levels! With rapid shrinking circles, intense fights, and strategic use of items, come challenge your in-game limits to crown the victory![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Update Details:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]>[/b] [b]Awakener Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Eos (Luminary):[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Diffraction (Ultimate): [/i]Duration increased from 20s to 25s. Now, downing an enemy extends the duration by 5s (up to a maximum of 25s).[/p][list][*][p][b]Xiva (Firestorm):[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Searing Munitions (Passive), Azure Divide (Tactical), & Corvite Storm (Ultimate):[/i] All abilities now apply an additional 25% slow effect that lasts for 2 seconds upon dealing damage.[/p][list][*][p][b]Soarwynne (Windranger):[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Skyward Leap (Tactical):[/i] Can now use weapons and items after the initial jump. The leap range has been adjusted from 13m ~ 35m to 7m ~ 35m.[/p][quote][p]Dev Note: "Soarwynne is currently underperforming compared to other Assault Awakeners. We want Skyward Leap to create more opportunities for high-impact plays. By increasing her options for jump height and allowing her to act during the leap, we hope to make her more dynamic."[/p][/quote][p][/p][h3][b]>[/b] [b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Gladiator Assault Rifle:[/b] Damage reduced (Upper Body: 35 → 33, Lower Body: 27 → 25). Increased long-range damage falloff.Slightly increased recoil.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]Dev Note: "Our goal for the Gladiator AR is for it to be a high-skill weapon that rewards practice. Currently, its ease of use is too similar to the entry-level CL-4 AR, and its high damage is crowding out other weapons. These adjustments are intended to better define its role."[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed several issues that could cause crashes, stuttering, or frame drops.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a UI display issue when DLSS Frame Generation was enabled.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed UI display issues that could occur after setting custom keybinds.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause interaction problems after setting custom keybinds.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug with deadzone settings for PlayStation controllers.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed various general controller interaction bugs.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue causing some missions to not track progress correctly.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue preventing recruitment/squad information from being deleted.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug with custom color settings for squad banners.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed several issues with the voice chat function.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug causing player stats to display incorrectly.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed display issues with some Charms.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue causing muzzle flash effects to display incorrectly.[/p][p][b]>[/b]  Fixed a bug where players could be repeatedly teleported while inside an updraft area.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue in some areas that could cause players to get stuck in a floating state.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug where the backpack UI would display incorrectly after reconnecting to a match.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue preventing ziplines from being used correctly.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Eos's Tactical ability to fail on activation.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue that allowed Ryoin to use his long-range leap while on a zipline.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from picking up equipment in the Training Grounds.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]Please remember that this CBT build does not represent the final version of the game. If you encounter any issues, please [/i][/p][p]join our official Discord server [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]https://discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url][/p][p][i] to submit bug reports and feedback. Our team will follow up and address them promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.[/i][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p]
[/p][p]Fate Trigger Dev Team[/p]

tags.balance_change: Duration increased from 20s to 25s. Now, downing an enemy extends the duration by 5s (up to a maximum of 25s).
All abilities now apply an additional 25% slow effect that lasts for 2 seconds upon dealing damage.
Can now use weapons and items after the initial jump. The leap range has been adjusted from 13m ~ 35m to 7m ~ 35m.
Damage reduced (Upper Body: 35 → 33, Lower Body: 27 → 25). Increased long-range damage falloff.Slightly increased recoil.

tags.bug: > Fixed several issues that could cause crashes, stuttering, or frame drops.
> Fixed a UI display issue when DLSS Frame Generation was enabled.
> Fixed UI display issues that could occur after setting custom keybinds.
> Fixed an issue that could cause interaction problems after setting custom keybinds.
> Fixed a bug with deadzone settings for PlayStation controllers.
> Fixed various general controller interaction bugs.
> Fixed an issue causing some missions to not track progress correctly.
> Fixed an issue preventing recruitment/squad information from being deleted.
> Fixed a bug with custom color settings for squad banners.
> Fixed several issues with the voice chat function.
> Fixed a bug causing player stats to display incorrectly.
> Fixed display issues with some Charms.
> Fixed an issue causing muzzle flash effects to display incorrectly.
> Fixed a bug where players could be repeatedly teleported while inside an updraft area.
> Fixed an issue in some areas that could cause players to get stuck in a floating state.
> Fixed a bug where the backpack UI would display incorrectly after reconnecting to a match.
> Fixed an issue preventing ziplines from being used correctly.
> Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Eos's Tactical ability to fail on activation.
> Fixed an issue that allowed Ryoin to use his long-range leap while on a zipline.
> Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from picking up equipment in the Training Grounds.
